0.translation: Flexible parameter formats refine shared settings into local control for parameters that support them. These examples use the same four bundled sequences; the first three compare only ⟦shared:0⟧ on a 7 × 7 inch canvas. Requires ggchord and optional dplyr for CDS preparation.

5.translation: Every radius is 1. A scalar is sufficient when all sequences share a setting.

9.translation: Only ⟦shared:0⟧ uses 0.72; the rest retain this parameter's default of 1. Keys match actual ⟦shared:1⟧ values after display reordering. Keep complete named vectors when every sequence has a different setting.

14.translation: Values match display order after ⟦shared:0⟧ and must cover all displayed sequences. The second sequence is currently ⟦shared:1⟧, making this plot equivalent to the preceding one.

16.translation: Keep the vector and change ⟦shared:0⟧. Named values still change ⟦shared:1⟧; the unnamed vector changes the second displayed sequence, now ⟦shared:2⟧.

20.translation: ## Prepare observed CDS on both strands ⟦shared:0⟧

23.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ has a plus-strand record at 2624–4195 and a minus-strand record at 19246–20523; the integrase on ⟦shared:1⟧ is plus-strand. Strands come from ⟦shared:2⟧, with original coordinates retained.

27.translation: Explicit strand values are already signed: 0.08 for plus and −0.08 for minus, without another reversal. A scalar ⟦shared:0⟧ expands to plus 0.08 and minus −0.08.

29.translation: Place the two ⟦shared:0⟧ strands asymmetrically, while the other sequence uses a smaller symmetric offset. A list expresses these two levels of variation.

32.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ uses explicit 0.08/−0.14; the scalar 0.06 for ⟦shared:1⟧ expands symmetrically. Omitted sequences or strands become 0 in this Position family. Do not copy this mixed list directly into ⟦shared:2⟧.

36.translation: Plus uses width 0.03 and minus 0.08. Width changes arrow thickness; start/end still determine interval length. Per-sequence width lists require elements following that family's strand-value rules; see [geometry parameters](⟦shared:0⟧).

40.translation: Text radii for ⟦shared:0⟧ and ⟦shared:1⟧ are 75% and 115% of their backbone radii. Other sequences keep their defaults. Explicit ⟦shared:2⟧ is incompatible with Collinear.

42.translation: | Interface | Formats and matching | Boundaries and omitted values |

44.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | Scalar, accver names, display order and corresponding scalar lists | ⟦shared:1⟧, ⟦shared:2⟧, ⟦shared:3⟧, ⟦shared:4⟧ have individual defaults and Coord support |

45.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧, radius, rotation, size and hjust/vjust by sequence | ⟦shared:2⟧ is a single mode; explicit radius is incompatible with Collinear |

46.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ / ⟦shared:1⟧ | ⟦shared:2⟧ by endpoint sequence | ⟦shared:3⟧ retains automatic behavior; control points are not sequence scalars |

47.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ / ⟦shared:1⟧ | ⟦shared:2⟧ by sequence or strand; list elements follow strand-value rules | Omitted entries retain the parameter default; arbitrary mixed Position lists do not apply |

48.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧: scalar, sequence values, explicit strand values and mixed sequence lists | Scalar x becomes +x/−x; explicit strands are not reversed; omitted sequences/strands become 0 |

49.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | Scalar or per-sequence scalar ⟦shared:1⟧s | Both strands share the ⟦shared:1⟧; strand-specific values are unsupported; omitted sequences become 0 |

50.translation: | Fixed ⟦shared:0⟧ / ⟦shared:1⟧ | ⟦shared:2⟧, ⟦shared:3⟧, ⟦shared:4⟧, ⟦shared:5⟧ by sequence or strand | Follow this family's strand rules; not every text parameter accepts lists |

51.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | One absolute ⟦shared:1⟧ or per-sequence numeric width/gap | Numeric settings cover every displayed sequence; absolute sizes retain their physical meaning |

52.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ specifies ordering and ⟦shared:1⟧ specifies a layout mode. Automatic label layers do not accept arbitrary fixed offsets. Axes/themes, aesthetics, scales and guides retain their own interfaces. Manual colour scales match **data categories**; see [styling](⟦shared:2⟧). Consult the [parameter atlas](⟦shared:3⟧) for exact defaults and ranges.

53.translation: ## Choose a format and check results ⟦shared:0⟧

54.translation: Use scalars for shared settings, named values for local differences, equal-length vectors for display-order settings, and supported lists when two levels of differences require them. Check IDs, order, omitted entries and actual results. Other sections use the simplest expression that serves their task; vector/list counts are not a quality measure.
